housing.text: Brandon says he approved every housing project considered during his county tenure, including 56 affordable units.
housing.quote: Approved every housing project, including initiating a partnership with the Stanislaus Regional Housing Authority (SRHA) for 56 approved affordable units

cannabis.text: Brandon says he campaigned as pro-cannabis and introduced a county legalization proposal for dispensaries and cultivation.
cannabis.quote: I ran and won with a public pro-cannabis position and introduced legalization to the board for dispensaries and connected in-county cultivation.

tax.text: Duarte supports cutting state taxes and reducing fraud and abuse in California's budget.
tax.quote: Alexandra supports cutting taxes and cutting fraud and abuse from California's budget.

safety.text: Duarte supports increased investment in law enforcement to address crime.
safety.quote: Alexandra believes that shoplifting is a crime, that criminals belong in jail, and that we need to invest more in our law enforcement to make sure that happens.

sentencing.text: Duarte supports stricter criminal sentences to keep dangerous offenders incarcerated.
sentencing.quote: Alexandra also supports stricter sentencing to keep dangerous criminals off our streets.

immigration.text: Duarte pledges to close the border and end California's sanctuary policies.
immigration.quote: I will shut the border. End Sanctuary laws. Protect our daughters.

guns.text: Duarte supports making firearm permits, ammunition, and guns easier to obtain.
guns.quote: Alexandra will protect our God-given 2nd Amendment rights, making permits more available, ammo cheaper, and guns easier to buy.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Duarte opposes allowing transgender girls and women to participate in girls' and women's sports.
gender.quote: Schools should not be able to hide their radical agendas from parents, and biological males do NOT belong in women’s and girls’ sports.

energy.text: Duarte supports expanding oil drilling and employment in the oil industry.
energy.quote: It’s time to drill, baby, drill, and let our oilmen get to work.

voting.text: Duarte supports voter identification requirements, election audits, and voter-roll reviews.
voting.quote: Alexandra will fight for voter ID, real election audits, and clean voter rolls.
